The Marsh & Co Workshop

For forty years the workshop on Mill Lane turned oak and ash into chairs that outlasted the people who ordered them. Each one was cut, joined, and oiled by hand, and each carried a small brass plate with the year it was finished stamped into the back rail.

The last order left the bench in the spring the lease ran out. The tools were sold, the lane was redeveloped, and the site went quiet. This page is all that remains of the shop that stood there, kept only because the Internet Archive happened to save a copy before the server went dark.
